title: The Paw Mage
description: A woman with long white braided hair wearing a crown and flowing teal gown stands in a dark fantasy landscape, holding a heavy chain connected to a large glowing blue paw symbol floating in a cracked glass orb. The orb pours glowing water and paw prints onto the stone ground. Behind her is a dark castle, dripping red moon with a paw print, and purple flowers.
prompt: A mystical woman with long white braid and crown wearing a flowing teal and purple gown stands in a dark fantasy garden holding a heavy chain attached to a glowing blue neon paw symbol inside a cracked glass orb on a pedestal. The orb spills glowing water and white and black paw prints onto the stone floor. In the background a dark gothic castle, dripping blood-red moon with a large paw print in the center, purple roses and teal succulents, dramatic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere
